content.title: About
content.content: Topping, nuts and syrup is a blend of roasted nuts (almonds, walnuts, hazelnuts, etc.) combined with a fragrant sweet syrup, used to garnish desserts, ice cream, pastries and drinks. The nuts provide crunch, while the syrup adds a smooth sweetness and aroma.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The mix often includes several nut varieties, increasing its nutritional value.
The syrup can be made from sugar, honey or maple syrup, sometimes flavored with vanilla or cinnamon.
Topping is widely used in cafés and bakeries to create a visual “cover” effect.
Nuts retain most of their healthy fats and vitamins when not overheated.
The blend can be gluten‑free, but always check for trace grain contamination in the packaging.

items.title: Rich in healthy fats
items.content: Nuts contain monounsaturated and polyunsaturated fatty acids that support heart health.

items.title: Vitamins and minerals
items.content: The mix provides vitamin E, magnesium, phosphorus and antioxidants that contribute to overall wellbeing.

items.title: Energy boost
items.content: The combination of nuts and sugar offers a quick and sustained source of energy.

items.title: Dietary fiber
items.content: Nuts add fiber, which aids digestion and promotes satiety.

items.title: Antioxidant effect
items.content: Vitamin E and polyphenols in the nuts help protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Tree nut allergy
items.content: The topping can trigger allergic reactions in individuals sensitive to nuts.

items.title: High in calories
items.content: The blend is calorie‑dense, so it should be consumed in moderation.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: The syrup raises blood sugar levels, which is important for people with diabetes to consider.

items.title: Choking hazard for children
items.content: Whole nuts can be a choking risk for young children; finely chopped pieces are recommended.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Sprinkle the topping over ice cream, yogurt, pancakes, waffles, cakes, coffee or smoothies. It can also be folded into batter or used as a finishing garnish on baked goods.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep in an airtight container in a cool, dry place away from direct light. For longer shelf life, store in the refrigerator to prevent the nuts from going rancid.
